note: No. 17's comparison of five ways to give a local agent historian data, from research/q2-vendors.md, q3-security.md and q4-findability.md and No. 18's build. good / depends / bad, with the reason shown on the page.
criteria: Does it find the right tag?

options.name: A file export
options.what: Someone exports the tag list and a slice of data to a file the agent reads.
leave: No, with the model, tools and logs on site and the server's routes out closed.
load: Only while the export is made.
find: The whole tag list is 13 times the model's window; the agent sees what was exported, nothing newer.

options.name: The agent's own login
options.what: The agent writes its own queries against the historian's web API or database with an account of its own.
change: Whatever the account may do: the PI web API also writes.
leave: No, with the model, tools and logs on site and the server's routes out closed.
load: Nothing stops a ten-year, one-second query.
find: It guesses names: an ABB historian prototype chose the right identifiers in 18 of 30 questions.

options.name: A vendor's cloud assistant
options.what: The vendor's assistant reads data the site has published to the vendor's cloud.
change: Depends on the vendor's tools: some can change workbooks or settings.
leave: Yes: the published data and the values the model reads go to a cloud model.
find: Through the vendor's asset model, where the site has built one.

options.name: Read-only tools
options.what: A small set of fixed tools on a read-only account: browse the asset tree, read a series, with limits on each call.
change: No: the tools only read, and so does the account.
leave: No, with the model, tools and logs on site and the server's routes out closed.
load: Limits per call on tags, values and window, and on calls per minute.
find: By browsing the tree level by level: slow, and the agent can lose its way.

options.name: Read-only tools and a tag catalogue
options.what: The same tools, plus a catalogue of every tag, crawled nightly, which the agent searches by place and the site's words; a skill tells it how.
change: No: the tools only read, and so does the account.
leave: No, with the model, tools and logs on site and the server's routes out closed.
load: Limits per call and per minute; the crawl runs at night.
find: No. 18's search put on average 0.915 of the right tags in its top 10 (keyword search given the same place filter: 0.938); dead tags flagged before reading.
